operator_shapes: B=1, N=S, S=131/245/384, H=4, D=32; synthetic CPU-seeded operands. Broad independent-group layout tests and real Protenix-v2 training cover H=2/8 as well.
training: Protenix-v2, 48 Pairformer and 4 MSA blocks; crops 131 and 245. Nonzero Adam update audited at step 1, learning rate 0.00018.
inference: 9 models, G01 693 tokens and G02 245 tokens; cycle=1, step=1, sample=1 screening protocol. This is not production 200-step sampling acceptance.
